author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Looking for Illustrator for Participation/Democracy Stickers
content: Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio.
